column1: #build label(starter_workshops) start(1; 1) message(Build your first workshop hall; carpenter and mason on top; mechanic and craftsdwarf below.)

description: Four core early-fort workshops in a compact hall: carpenter and mason on top; mechanic and craftsdwarf below. Each 3x3 shop is a full footprint with one-tile aisles between so haulers can reach every station. Build near your stone and wood stockpiles.
